scope: Original PLY-3 GUI Split, GUI component Extract, Undo, and public-MCP Extract

admissionComparisonProbe.limitation: Sampled allocation estimates from a manufactured microprofile are not a measure of total application memory.

normalReplayAfterAdmissionChange.outcome: Browser command timed out after component inventory and before GUI Extract verification

typedFiniteProbe.scope: Three million finite Float32 values in an isolated browser
typedFiniteProbe.limitation: Sampled allocations are estimates on a manufactured input and do not measure full application memory.

inventoryDiagnosticCollection.limitation: Explicit diagnostic collection changes runtime behavior; these renderer measurements are not peak owned-job memory.

normalReplayAfterIndexedInventory.outcome: GUI Extract, Undo and MCP Extract completed; browser timed out during MCP output digest

digestSampling.scope: Original-scan diagnostic replay with explicit collection before digest; sampled allocation includes collected objects
digestSampling.limitation: Samples are estimates, and diagnostic collection changes runtime behavior.

digestSamplingAfterValidationChange.scope: Same original-scan diagnostic sequence with explicit collection before digest
digestSamplingAfterValidationChange.limitation: Samples are estimates and do not establish normal-run memory acceptance; collection and browser allocation timing differ.

normalReplayAfterDigestValidationChange.outcome: Browser command timed out after component inventory and before GUI Extract verification

arrayFiniteProbe.scope: Three million ordinary numeric-array values in an isolated browser
arrayFiniteProbe.limitation: Sampled allocation estimates are not total application memory.

normalReplayAfterArrayValidationChange.outcome: Browser command timed out after component inventory and before GUI Extract verification

encoderTimelineDiagnostic.scope: Normal original-scan run through first Extract timeout
encoderTimelineDiagnostic.traceControl: A separate small project export reported encoder start, result and termination.
encoderTimelineDiagnostic.limitation: This observation does not prove backups never overlap other workflows.

normalReplayAfterSelectionDeduplication.outcome: Browser command timed out after component inventory and before GUI Extract verification

normalReplayWithWorkerPreparedExtractDis.limitations: The browser heap is one stage observation, not total job memory. The large-scan run did not verify Extract Redo or save/reopen.

workerSourceReleaseExperiment.outcome: GUI Extract, Undo and MCP Extract completed; the final MCP digest timed out
workerSourceReleaseExperiment.disposition: Source-reference deletion was reverted because this run did not demonstrate a useful reduction; the separately tested monotonic progress correction was retained.

outerJobPeakTimeline.sampling: A copy of the existing guard queried its own outer Job peak every 0.5 seconds, reporting increases of at least 32 MiB. It preserved the 4 GiB Job limit, 25% CPU, mutex and cleanup policy.
outerJobPeakTimeline.limitation: High-water samples, not live memory; stage alignment is approximate and separate runs are subject to timing and garbage-collection variance. Both runs exceeded 4 GiB and cleaned up.

normalReplayAfterTypedFiniteChange.outcome: Browser command timed out after component inventory and before GUI Extract verification

limitation: Neither diagnostic collection nor the manufactured browser control establishes acceptance under the 4 GiB aggregate limit or native equivalence.

processMemorySamples.method: Outer Job threshold snapshots of process private bytes; values sampled after the high-water threshold, not simultaneous peak breakdowns.

hiddenGpuDisposalExperiment.disposition: Reverted; no observed reduction in peak and broader viewport behavior risk.

transferredInventoryReplay.limitations: No original-scan Extract Redo or save/reopen; this run did not test a public MCP inventory report.

publicMcpTransferredInventoryControl.scope: Manufactured indexed grid via public MCP; real-worker transfer has separate focused coverage.

typedInventoryAllocationSampling.scope: Original PLY-3 sampled from Split publication to GUI Extract and from Undo to MCP Extract; sampled sizes include collected objects.
typedInventoryAllocationSampling.limitations: Samples are estimates and must not be summed as live memory. Diagnostic sampling can change timing.

selectionIteratorExperiment.scope: Replaced large selection and boundary typed-array iterator loops with indexed loops
selectionIteratorExperiment.originalReplay: GUI Extract committed but GUI geometry digest timed out
selectionIteratorExperiment.disposition: Reverted because the replay did not establish an acceptance improvement.

allocationCallers.scope: Original PLY-3 sampled caller stacks during GUI and MCP Extract; sampled values include collected objects.
allocationCallers.limitation: Sample sizes are estimates, not live memory or a normal-run acceptance measurement.

publicationMaskDiagnostic.scope: Original PLY-3 sampling without explicit garbage collection
publicationMaskDiagnostic.overallResult: Failed on browser console error because temporary bundle lacked its offline service worker; worker generated afterward.
publicationMaskDiagnostic.guiEveryAndSelectionFrom: Not present among top 20 samples after changing publication validation and selection mask loops
publicationMaskDiagnostic.limitations: A sampled run and isolated fixture cannot establish normal-run resource acceptance. The finite-array helper still has a substantial sampled allocation; sampled sizes are estimates.

publicationMaskNormalFirstRun.build: same code; temporary bundle missing offline worker
publicationMaskNormalFirstRun.outcome: GUI Extract committed; GUI output digest timed out

publicationMaskNormalRepairedBundle.limitations: The large-scan run does not verify Extract Redo or save/reopen.

finiteArrayConditionProbe.scope: Three million dense doubles in an isolated browser; diagnostic sampling with explicit collection between variants.
finiteArrayConditionProbe.disposition: No helper change; the probe does not explain the much larger application-level helper sample.
finiteArrayConditionProbe.limitation: Sampled sizes are estimates from a manufactured isolated probe, not application peak memory.

localDisplayCoordinateProbe.scope: Three million precise coordinates in isolated browser; explicit collection between variants
localDisplayCoordinateProbe.limitation: Sampled allocation estimates from a manufactured microprofile, not total or peak application memory.

localDisplayCoordinateOriginalReplay.outcome: MCP connection closed during GUI Extract; no large Extract geometry result verified
localDisplayCoordinateOriginalReplay.limitation: Single run; peak and process timing vary. Extract Redo, save/reopen and native comparison remain unverified.

guardPeakReceiptCorrection.scope: Local ignored diagnostic guard copy, not application code
guardPeakReceiptCorrection.issue: Previously the passed field did not consider the measured outer Job peak, so exit code zero could be labeled passed above the agreed 4 GiB threshold.
guardPeakReceiptCorrection.change: The guard requires a measured nonnegative peak at or below its unchanged 4 GiB Job limit before reporting passed.
guardPeakReceiptCorrection.limitation: The over-limit boundary was tested in the pure check, not by allocating beyond the limit; previous receipts remain unchanged.

selectionTriplesProbe.scope: Three million precise coordinates in isolated browser, one-third million selected triangles
selectionTriplesProbe.disposition: No application change; small isolated difference does not explain the much larger application-level sample.
selectionTriplesProbe.limitation: Sampled allocation estimates do not measure application peak.

holeyFiniteProbe.scope: Three million precise coordinates restored from Float64 into a preallocated ordinary array in an isolated browser
holeyFiniteProbe.disposition: No helper change; the existing bounds check sampled less in this isolated probe.
holeyFiniteProbe.limitation: Sampled allocation estimates do not explain application-level sample or establish peak memory.

peakEnforcedOriginalReplay.outcome: GUI Extract committed; browser bridge timed out during GUI output digest
peakEnforcedOriginalReplay.limitation: This run did not verify GUI/MCP output equality, large Extract history or native comparison.

preciseRestoreProbe.scope: Three million Float64 values restored into ordinary arrays in an isolated browser
preciseRestoreProbe.disposition: Retain the current preallocated restore loop.
preciseRestoreProbe.limitation: Sampled allocation estimates from a manufactured probe, not application peak.

transportReleaseProbe.scope: Browser diagnostic: 20 million Float64 values copied into an ordinary array, then source ArrayBuffer transferred to size zero
transportReleaseProbe.limitation: CDP renderer backing-storage snapshots are not aggregate job peak memory.

indexedExtractTransportRelease.scope: Exact indexed Extract releases unreferenced owned worker buffers after restoration and result validation; referenced buffers and unsupported transfer implementations remain intact.
indexedExtractTransportRelease.ownershipTests: Unshared, result alias and unsupported transfer pass

originalReplay.outcome: GUI Extract committed, GUI digest timed out

indexedExtractTransportRelease.limitation: The manufactured control and targeted ownership tests do not establish original-scan memory acceptance, large-scan history, or native equivalence.

selectionOverlayRetirement.scope: Retire old selection display before publishing a different selected mesh; retain it when the next entity shares the same positions.
selectionOverlayRetirement.viewportTests: Different-position retirement, disposal, rebuilding, and shared-position retention pass.

originalReplay.outcome: GUI Extract committed; browser bridge timed out during GUI output digest

selectionOverlayRetirement.limitation: The single original replay does not demonstrate memory acceptance, large-scan parity/history, or native equivalence.

selectionScratchReleaseExperiment.scope: Immediately transfer exclusively owned boundary scratch buffers to zero length after each use, with a no-transfer fallback.
selectionScratchReleaseExperiment.focusedTests: Outline oracle, input preservation, transfer and fallback controls passed.

originalReplay.outcome: GUI Extract committed, browser bridge timed out during GUI output digest

selectionScratchReleaseExperiment.disposition: Reverted; the original replay did not demonstrate an end-to-end resource improvement.
selectionScratchReleaseExperiment.limitation: This single replay does not establish large-scan geometry, history, native behavior, or memory acceptance.

polymorphicValidatorProbe.scope: Three million restored double coordinates in isolated browser; same validator after mixed-array warmup versus a separate validator
polymorphicValidatorProbe.limitation: Sampling estimates and synthetic warmup do not measure normal application peak.

restoredValidatorCandidate.scope: Worker-restored arrays use a separate finite validator; all entries are still rechecked and sparse semantics preserved.
restoredValidatorCandidate.focusedTests: Validation after mutation and sparse-slot behavior, worker and MCP tests pass.

normalOriginalReplay.outcome: GUI Extract committed; GUI digest timed out

diagnosticOriginalReplay.validatorSample: No sampled allocation attributed to either finite-array validator in MCP Extract profile
diagnosticOriginalReplay.limitation: Explicit collection changes execution and is not resource acceptance; profiling samples are estimates and earlier profiles used different collection timing.

restoredValidatorCandidate.limitation: Large-scan normal memory, Extract Redo/save-reopen and native acceptance remain open.

scalarSelectionCorner.scope: Selection overlay triangle corners use one byte per vertex instead of three; vertex shader reconstructs the same one-hot barycentric values.
scalarSelectionCorner.focusedTests: Boundary ordering and shader attribute tests pass.

renderedComparison.scenario: GUI component operation held with reduced motion
renderedComparison.limitation: One small rendered control; not all cameras, hardware or motion states.

originalReplay.outcome: GUI Extract committed; browser bridge timed out during GUI output digest

scalarSelectionCorner.limitation: The original replay does not establish large-scan geometry, history, native behavior or 4 GiB acceptance.

digestStallTrace.scope: Original PLY-3 GUI Extract followed by public-MCP geometry digest with job-stage and browser-event logging.
digestStallTrace.outcome: Subsequent job_get timed out; no page-crash event was reported before cleanup.
digestStallTrace.rendererProcessObservation: Renderer process remained present and reported Responding in Windows during the wait; this does not establish that its page event loop was responsive.
digestStallTrace.limitation: The cause of the stalled bridge is not established; no large-scan digest equality or native acceptance is shown.

normal.pageHeartbeat: no response within 3 seconds; later closed during cleanup

digestResponsivenessComparison.limitation: Explicit collection and heartbeat instrumentation change execution; the diagnostic is not a normal-run acceptance pass. No page crash was observed before cleanup, and the precise cause of the stall is not proven.

splitTransportRelease.scope: After precise Split restoration, release unreferenced worker transport buffers; preserve result and input aliases and fall back if transfer is unavailable.
splitTransportRelease.ownershipTests: Unshared, result-alias, input-alias, aliased coordinates, and no-transfer cases pass.

normalOriginalReplay.outcome: GUI Extract committed; GUI digest timed out

splitTransportRelease.comparison: The preceding baseline reported approximately 971 MB browser heap at inventory; separate runs and browser memory accounting vary.
splitTransportRelease.limitation: Browser heap is not aggregate job memory. Large Extract digest, Redo/save/reopen, memory and native acceptance remain open.

guiDigestAllocationProfile.scope: Original PLY-3 GUI Extract digest sampled after diagnostic garbage collection.
guiDigestAllocationProfile.limitation: Explicit collection and sampling change execution; sampled allocations are estimates, and this is not normal-run memory acceptance.

selectionOwnedBufferRelease.scope: Release only private selection overlay position, corner and line-instance buffers after removal and disposal.

renderedControl.scenario: GUI component operation held with reduced motion

normalOriginalReplay.outcome: GUI Extract committed; browser bridge timed out during GUI output digest

selectionGrowthReleaseTrace.limitations: Separate instrumented runs; tracked constructors and selected transfers only. Not normal-run acceptance.

indexedSelectionIterationNormalRun.limitation: This does not cover large Extract Redo/save/reopen or native acceptance.
